draftArchitecture.plainAnswer: A matching term found in fewer files is more distinguishing within that collection; giving its match a higher score can lift a result above equally matched but less specific files.
causalSequence: Search six work files for pension plan.
Plan occurs in five files; pension in two, so pension identifies a smaller subset.
Equal scores leave the pension-only file tied with four plan-only files.
The historical method gives matches1 and3 points; summing those scores puts the pension-only file alone in second.
Both terms still count; this does not make the result true or guarantee it is what you need.
draftArchitecture.workedCase: Six work files: Pension plan changes; Project plan; Hiring plan; Travel plan; Marketing plan; Pension contribution limits. Query pension plan. Equal scores2/1/1/1/1/1 become4/1/1/1/1/3.
draftArchitecture.transferCase: If plan appears in fewer files than pension in a different collection, plan becomes the more distinguishing term there; the weighting must change.
draftArchitecture.usefulAction: Choose Post or Story, download the prepared graphic, optionally copy the caption or open the share sheet.
draftArchitecture.formatSpecificStructure: Three numbered social images: query/files, frequency/points, then results. Large text throughout; set/individual download and optional caption.
draftArchitecture.antiTemplateDecision: No private reflection, completion scores, reassurance or generic One-X slogan. Search scores are necessary to depict this mechanism.
